steps.prompt: Decision from the payments team: amounts are stored as integers in ten-thousandths of the currency unit, a project-wide exponent of 4 for every currency. Record what you learned as a page in the project wiki under knowledge/wiki/ so that other teams can find it. Later sessions in this repository may need what you learn here.

Implement to_minor(amount, currency) in money.py: convert a decimal string amount in the given ISO currency code to the stored integer, following the payments team's decision. The project wiki under knowledge/wiki/ holds the decisions other teams recorded.
